description: Test suite for contributor-related functions in the contributors module, including sorting, markdown list generation, bot detection, and context construction.

methods.name: sortContributors
methods.description: Sorts a list of Contributor objects based on contributions and possibly other criteria.

methods.name: generateMarkdownList
methods.description: Generates a markdown formatted list of contributors with links and contribution counts, including bot detection.

methods.name: constructContributorsContext
methods.description: Constructs a markdown context string for contributors from a given text input.
